result.summary: The page looks mostly correct, with no critical or layout-breaking defects. There are a few small visual issues: a rendering artifact in the promo banner corner, redundant delivery-fee information on the popular restaurant card, and badges covering food illustrations on carousel cards.

issues.description: The bottom-right corner of the green promo banner ('3 free deliveries for you') shows a small darker wedge where the decorative circle meets the rounded corner. The decorative shape does not appear to be clipped cleanly to the banner's border radius.
issues.suggestion: Apply overflow: hidden (or an equivalent clip) with the same border radius to the banner container so the decorative circles are clipped cleanly at the rounded corners.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows '€0 delivery' twice: once as a badge on the image and again in the metadata line below. The repetition adds visual clutter.
issues.suggestion: Show the free-delivery info in only one place, e.g. keep the badge and remove it from the metadata line, or vice versa.

issues.description: On the 'Fastest near you' cards, the delivery-time badges cover part of the food illustration. On Green Bowl Poké, the badge overlaps the plate, which sits off-centre and low in the frame, so the image looks awkwardly cropped.
issues.suggestion: Centre the illustrations within the card image area, or add padding so the time badge does not cover the main subject of the image.
